method.coverage: Read primary 12-second development and held input hashes unchanged. Preserve the exact previous numeric lane and status for the primary study. Supplementary stress uses the exact same source prompts/background with two distinct global EQ curves: two-pole lowpass 1900 Hz and 5 dB high-shelf above 2000 Hz. No metric or signal from the base held ledger influences the fixed guard arithmetic.
method.gate: Across all three held levels, decline all wrong references, suppress at least three of the four original EQ false findings at -5 dB with zero suppressed correct real/synthetic ranges at that level, and suppress at least half of any alternate-curve flags at each level. Report secondary readout separately. Do not claim untreated EQ controls are new source groups.
method.guard: Measure whole-recording shared-signal transfer in five frequency bands. Fit signed amplitude gain to the clean earlier waveform with a tapered FFT and energy-weighted real cross spectra. Require a broad tilt of at least .35 and temporal agreement in at least two of three four-second parts, including first and last. A supported EQ explanation suppresses only the long comparison's local flag and contributes no AI confidence.
